title: Console: add Scaling History panel for Dedicated pools (clamp explanations + runbook links)
author: Nora Ahmed
description: Context: Dedicated autoscaling now emits structured scaling events including clamp details (see console backend endpoints in PR #22003, and autoscaler clamp metrics in PR #21912). Customers have asked for transparency into why replicas changed and whether we hit min/max bounds (SUP-4821, SUP-4874). This PR adds a new Console panel, “Scaling History”, on Dedicated Pool detail pages. The panel lists scaling events with plain-language explanations, highlights when desired replicas were clamped to customer min/max, and provides a direct link to the oncall runbook for “bounded max -> throttling / latency spike” scenarios. Changes included: (1) New “Scaling History” tab in Dedicated pool details, behind the existing bounded-autoscaling feature flag/allowlist gate so we can dogfood with design partners first. (2) Table view with pagination, time range filter, event-type filter (ScaleUp, ScaleDown, Clamp, Freeze/Pin), and a “Why?” drawer that expands the event and renders explanation text. (3) Clamp explanations: when clamp_reason is set, we show a structured explanation: requested desired replicas, applied replicas, bound hit (min/max), and the customer-configured value at the time of decision; additionally we show the top contributing signals if present in the event payload (queue depth trend, p95 latency, utilization), but we intentionally avoid rendering raw signal arrays to keep the UI stable and avoid leaking high-cardinality data. (4) Copy + guidance: for max clamps, we show a warning banner (“Autoscaler wanted to scale higher than your Max. You may see throttling/latency during bursts.”) with a link to “Dedicated autoscaling anomalies runbook” and a second link to “How to tune min/max bounds” (placeholder route for docs; shipped as “coming soon” tooltip until docs are live). (5) RBAC and audit: UI consumes the backend endpoint that enforces pool-level read permissions; we do not show any actor info in the event list unless the backend event type is ConfigChange and includes an actor that the viewer is allowed to see (future work; this PR just renders the field if present). (6) Visual polish: aligns with Console design system (DataTable, Drawer, Callout), adds empty states (no events, filters remove all), and includes “Export CSV” that uses server-side pagination to avoid loading full history into the browser. Screenshots are attached below in the PR for reviewer sanity. Implementation notes: The UI expects the event payload shape shipped by PR #22003 (backend). We added a thin adapter layer to handle older payloads while the rollout is staged; in practice, older payloads will render as a generic message (“Scaled to N replicas”) and the “Why?” drawer will show “Details unavailable for this event version.” This should prevent front-end crashes during mixed-region rollouts. Tests: Added unit tests for clamp explanation renderer and filter state; added Playwright smoke for opening the panel and expanding a clamp event (skipped in CI until the seeded test data is available in the console e2e env—see TODO). Checklist: - [x] Behind feature flag (console.boundedAutoscalingHistory) - [x] Handles empty/partial payloads - [x] No PII in event rendering - [x] Adds telemetry (panel_open, event_expand, export_click) - [x] Accessibility pass (keyboard navigation for Drawer, aria labels on filters) Follow-ups: (a) Add docs page for “tuning bounds” and wire the link (tracked in ENG-2872). (b) Render ConfigChange actor + diff once audit events include that reliably (ENG-2891). (c) Replace “Details unavailable” message when we complete the backfill/migration for old events (ENG-2850).

review_conversation: Jada Williams (requested changes): The panel looks good, but please make sure we never show raw policy IDs or internal region codes in the explanation. Also: the Drawer header should include pool name + event timestamp for screenshots/support cases. Nora Ahmed (author): Good call—hid policy_id entirely and mapped region to displayName when present; added Drawer header with pool + timestamp; pushed 2 commits. Allison Grant: For clamp_reason, can we standardize the copy to match what SRE uses in runbooks ("clamped to customer max" / "clamped to customer min")? Also, please add a link to the runbook in the clamp warning itself, not only in the footer. Nora Ahmed: Updated strings to match runbook phrasing and added runbook link in the warning callout. Aisha Bello: Please ensure we don’t page-support by encouraging customers to spam export; rate limit might be needed later. Also verify that the UI doesn’t request more than 30d by default. Nora Ahmed: Default is 24h with quick presets (24h/7d/30d). Export uses current filter window and pages server-side. Alicia Perez: Minor UX—filter chips should show active state and there should be an empty state illustration (or at least text) when no events. Nora Ahmed: Added active filter pills and empty state copy. Chloe Martin: Backend endpoint returns signal_summary optionally—UI should treat it as best-effort and not assume fields. Also confirm compatibility with event_version v1/v2. Nora Ahmed: Added adapter + defensive rendering; added test fixtures for v1/v2. Approvals: Jada Williams (approved), Allison Grant (approved), Chloe Martin (approved).
